protocol: Continuous rollout to environment termination or configured evaluation horizon (maximum 400 steps) from existing CoFlow policy and RWM checkpoints. Eight candidates, three denoising steps, requested H=8 capped by policy horizon. Only the first action of the highest predicted return is executed. Predictions are raw model observation and reward outputs, not simulator outcomes. No full candidate simulator replay is claimed.

selection.purpose: Successful illustrative example, selected by final simulator outcome; not an aggregate performance estimate.
